title: eludite.git.checkout input
description: Check out a branch, remote branch or revision (the Git Repository window's Checkout, the status bar's branch list), or create one and switch to it (New Branch: `create`, from `start_point`, default HEAD). A remote branch with no local branch of its name gets a local tracking branch. Local changes that the switch would overwrite refuse the checkout naming them (libgit2's safe checkout); other local changes come along. `force` overwrites them and is refused for agents. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.

name.description: A branch (`feature`, `origin/feature`), tag or commit; with `create`, the new branch's name.

create.description: Create the branch `name` first. Default false.

start_point.description: Where a created branch starts. Default HEAD.

force.description: Overwrite local changes. Refused for agents.
